stem: Which menstrual-cycle phase features endometrial secretion of nutrient-rich fluid in preparation for implantation?

options.label: A
options.text: The proliferative phase of the cycle
options.misconception: Substitutes a different cycle label for the source-defined secretory phase.
options.explanation: The checked passage names the nutrient-secreting endometrial stage the secretory phase, not the proliferative phase.

options.label: B
options.text: The menses phase of the cycle
options.misconception: Substitutes a different cycle label for the source-defined secretory phase.
options.explanation: The checked passage names the nutrient-secreting endometrial stage the secretory phase, not the menses phase.

options.label: C
options.text: The ischemic phase of the cycle
options.misconception: Substitutes a different cycle label for the source-defined secretory phase.
options.explanation: The checked passage names the nutrient-secreting endometrial stage the secretory phase, not the ischemic phase.

options.label: D
options.text: The follicular phase of the ovary
options.misconception: Substitutes an ovarian phase label for the source-defined endometrial phase.
options.explanation: The checked passage calls this endometrial stage the secretory phase; it separately names the post-ovulatory ovarian stage the luteal phase.

options.label: E
options.text: The secretory phase of the cycle
options.misconception: Recognizes the exact phase definition stated in the checked passage.
options.explanation: The secretory phase features endometrial secretion of nutrient-rich fluid in preparation for embryo implantation.

context: Learning objective: name the nutrient-secreting endometrial phase. The secretory phase prepares for implantation with nutrient-rich fluid, while the source calls the post-ovulatory ovarian phase of progesterone secretion the luteal phase.
imageCaption: Menstrual cycle: follicular E, LH surge, luteal P; secretory endometrium; corpus luteum; menopause; oxytocin.
